articles.title: Live: France orders evacuations near Bordeaux as wildfires sweep through southwest
articles.description: French authorities ordered the evacuation of towns near the southwestern city of Bordeaux on Saturday "as a precaution", as wildfires moved towards the area. Intense wildfires have forced more than 200,000 people to flee their homes in southwestern France and central Spain. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

The decision at a U.N. articles.description: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres touched down in Damascus Saturday for a three-day visit where he is expected to reaffirm support for the multi-confessional country's efforts to rebuild after more than a decade of bloody civil war.

articles.title: Trump lashes out at 'fake news' and jokes about 2028 presidential run in press gala do-over
articles.description: US President Donald Trump delivered an at-times rambling speech at the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner Friday, three months after an alleged assassination attempt brought the annual event to an abrupt halt. Trump notably joked about running for a third presidential term in 2028, which is barred under the US Constitution.

articles.title: Yemen's Houthis say they hit Saudi Arabia as Trump weighs harder Iran strikes
articles.description: Yemen's Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for a missile attack on the city of Jizan in Saudi Arabia on Saturday as the fallout of the US-Israeli war against Iran spreads further across the Middle East. The Iran-backed group last week announced a maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia and has targeted its ships in the Red Sea.

articles.description: Plus de 19 000 hectares ont déjà été dévorés par les flammes en Gironde et les incendies se dirigent désormais vers la métropole bordelaise, selon la préfète de Nouvelle-Aquitaine, qui a annoncé des évacuations supplémentaires à venir dans plusieurs villes près de Bordeaux.
